title: console: first authenticated load pulls 336 eager JS chunks (~11.7 MB decoded)
body:
Ruled: 6054102412 · letter A · 2026-10-08T06:44Z

**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: production build of objectui `179f6fe9`: the first authenticated load fetched 336 JS chunks, ~11.7 MB decoded; the build log reports "336/2452 chunks eager"; `dist` is 62 MB / 3,602 files.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

Measured with Playwright on a cold context after sign-in. In-Studio navigation afterwards is fast (180–400 ms per pillar), so the cost is concentrated in the first load.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Find which plugins enter the eager closure on the authenticated shell and lazy-load Studio, the flow canvas and chart engines by route; set a size budget for the eager set.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *eager closure chunks bundle size first load*: 5 hits (0 open, 5 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#10996 (closed) — eager-closure budget family
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#10065 (closed) — eager-closure reduction family
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11672 (closed) — listed 'Eager closure 3.24 MiB gzip over 331 chunks' under 'Not filed' (within the budget gate)
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: eager closure chunk count first load · bundle size 336 chunks · eager js size
